name: More Realistic Gore
author: wolfsdk
description: Gives every weapon class its own gore table instead of the very restrained stock values (out of the box the pistol and SMG only know SMALL_WOUND). Also uses GORETYPE_DECAPITATION, GORETYPE_TORSO_SPLIT and GORETYPE_DISINTIGRATE, which the engine knows but the game does not use in a single table. Every effect is tied through damageModifiers to the damage actually dealt: a grazing shot wounds, a point-blank shotgun blast tears apart.
